title: Ledger-Mold Bloom
text: Pale mold writes fraudulent debts across every local counter. On failure, lose up to 1 Salvage and fix this Hazard to the sector. While fixed, every service in the sector is locked until the Bloom is cleared.
flavor: The first receipt is always for your own name.

successEffect.text: You voided the false accounts and reopened the sector's counters.
